item.title: Mamdani pitches Trump on housing with mock newspaper in latest White House visit
item.description: President Donald Trump has met with New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani at the White House to talk about big federal housing investments. Mamdani on Thursday presented Trump with a mock New York Daily News cover that reads “Trump to City: Let’s Build.” His team says the goal is to show Trump the positive headlines a deal could generate. item.description: Kuzmich, a five-year starting senior, averages 26 points six assists and five rebounds per game for the No. 1-seeded Witches in Class C. She has over 2,300 career points, which ranks her in the top 10 all time for Section 2. item.title: Five face drug charges after search of Albany apartments
item.description: The Albany County Sheriff’s Office said investigators searched four apartments on North Allen Street, Washington Avenue, Third Avenue and North Main Avenue on Feb. 25 and Feb. 26. They found about 215 grams of crack cocaine, 6 grams of fentanyl, digital scales, packaging materials, about 3 pounds of cannabis, two high-capacity ammunition feeding devices and two guns, investigators said.
